title: The leash on the hook
logline: The leash on its hook by the garage door, and beside it the old leash from 1999, kept, shorter, the clip rusted. Two leashes. The page's arithmetic: twenty-two years.

panels.composition: Two dog leashes on hooks beside a garage door: a newer one and beside it an old short leash with a rusted clip, a coat on the next hook.
